d:
Nitish setu ke udghatan se pahle bihar ki rajniti men naya vivad khara ho gaya hai. sarkari vigyapan aur postar se nitish kumar ki tasvir gayab hone ke bad saval uth rahe hain ki kya nitish kumar piem modi ke sath manch sajha nahin karenge? 21 navanbar ko vaishali ke rajapakar men hone vale karyakram par sabki najar hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
